{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gluss'elta Islands''' were a group of islands located on the planet [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. The [[Gluss'sa'Nikto]] subspecies of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] hailed from this area of the planet.
